title: Remote processing and central-fill details on hold
rule_summary: Detailed remote-processing and central-fill allocation of responsibility remains on hold until all current Board policies and applicable federal record requirements are reconciled.
exam_relevance: Tests whether the candidate can apply remote and central processing requirements to a pharmacy-practice scenario without substituting a nearby rule.

authority.name: Remote processing and central-fill details on hold

exceptions: Apply any narrower setting-specific, product-specific, or emergency exception before the general rule.
common_confusions: Confusing remote and central processing with a nearby rule that has a different trigger or deadline.
verification_notes: HOLD: authoritative sources are not yet reconciled; no question may cite this rule.
